date.as_written: samvat a 0((8))2 bhādrapadakṛṣṇa trayodaśyāṃ; samvat a 0[(8)] 3†5†jya///? (second colophon); verse: trayo dhikesītisate gate abde māse ‥ jyeṣṭe kṛtakṛṣṇapakṣake aikādaśī somaprasasyasaṃjñake

notes: Composite colophon with several parts: (1) Mahāmāyūrī/Mahādaṇḍapāṇi section dated NS 182; (2) a Sanskrit verse (dated 183 = 'trayo dhikesītisate', i.e. 80+3+100) recording a consecration (pratiṣṭhā) of a book, images, vajra and bell, Pañcarakṣā and Cakrasaṃvara at Mānadeva-vihāra under King Śaṅkaradeva, by Ācārya Bhikṣu Ravendradeva (ācāryasya dhiyottamaḥ) — the name is 'bhikṣuravendradeva'; (3) NS 183(5?) dated entry under king '(pajuna)kāmadeva' = Pradyumnakāmadeva per catalogue, mentioning Ācārya Sthavira Ravendradeva of a mahāvihāra, with merit going to parents and all beings. The scribe is not named. The king in the verse is Śaṅkaradeva (a different, earlier-style reference, possibly quoted from the exemplar or a pratiṣṭhā record), while the NS 183 entry names Pradyumnakāmadeva (reading '(pajuna)1kāmadeva' is corrupt). The name 'Ravendradeva' may be a corruption of 'Ravīndradeva'/'Bhikṣu Ravendra'. 'Mānadeva-vihāra' is a vihāra name, not a person. Catalogue date NS 182, 183 and king Pradyumnakāmadeva are consistent with the colophon. The gaps hide the names of the guru/parents.
